$comment: Intent2Code STACK — the ONLY place stack versions live. Edit this file, then:
node .claude/skills/sap-conventions/scripts/stack.mjs resolve         → what a build will use (UI5 patch resolved + verified)
node .claude/skills/sap-conventions/scripts/stack.mjs apply <app>     → re-apply to an existing app (then npm install)
node .claude/skills/sap-conventions/scripts/stack.mjs check <app>     → drift report (also sanity static check 6)
node .claude/skills/sap-conventions/scripts/stack.mjs sync-docs       → regenerate the version tables/snippets in the docs
Never edit version literals in CLAUDE.md, skills or reference-apps — they are generated from this file.

plugin.$comment: Display version (zip name, README). plugin.json / mcp-server get the semver form (1.09 → 1.9.0).

$comment: Change ONLY cdsMajor to move the whole CAP stack; compat holds the matching drivers per major
(verified with npm view: @cap-js/sqlite@2 / @cap-js/hana@2 peer @sap/cds ^9.8; @3 peer ^10; cds 9 engines node >=20, cds 10 >=22).
The GLOBAL @sap/cds-dk (any major) is used only for scaffolding (cds init) — projects always pin these ranges.

node.$comment: engines.node written to the CAP root package.json. null = cap.compat[cdsMajor].node

$comment: Set the RELEASE LINE (e.g. 1.136 or 1.148 — both LTS). The newest patch of that line is resolved from
<cdn>/version.json (fallback: neo-app.json patch list) and verified (HEAD sap-ui-core.js = 200). Never a guessed patch.
pin = exact patch instead of the newest (still verified). minUI5Version: 'resolved' (the patch) or 'line' (<line>.0).

packages.$comment: A string = npm range, updated wherever the package already appears. An object can also ADD the package when its 'required' condition holds: capWithUi = CAP root that serves UI modules, uiModule = every UI module package.json (@ui5/linter runs locally via 'npm exec --no -- ui5lint', never downloaded).

generator.$comment: yo 4 is the last major compatible with @sap/generator-fiori headless (yo 5+ removed env.error).
